ov: ملفن وهاورد (الإنجليزية: Melvin and Howard) هو فيلم كوميدي تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1980. الفيلم من إخراج جوناثان ديم.
plotEn:
Billionaire Howard Hughes loses control of his motorcycle and crashes in the desert near Tonopah, Nevada. That night, he is discovered lying on the side of a stretch of U.S. Route 95 when Melvin Dummar, a magnesium plant worker, stops his pickup truck to urinate. The disheveled stranger, refusing to allow Melvin to take him to the hospital, asks him to instead drive him to Las Vegas. As Melvin makes small talk, the stranger reveals that he is Howard Hughes, but Melvin does not believe him. Melvin cajoles his passenger into joining him in singing a Christmas song he wrote. Howard then suggests they sing "Bye Bye Blackbird", which they do. The man warms to his rescuer and is dropped off in the parking lot of the Desert Inn.
Melvin returns to his trailer home in Gabbs, Nevada, which he shares with his wife Lynda and daughter Darcy. Later that morning, Lynda awakens and sees their motorcycle and pickup truck being repossessed. While Melvin is sleeping, Lynda takes Darcy and leaves for Reno. Lynda refuses to return to Melvin, but sends Darcy to live with her father. Heartbroken over Lynda, Melvin searches for her in Reno, where he finds her dancing in a sleazy strip club. Melvin loses his temper and causes a scene, leading Lynda to lose her job. While Lynda is working as a scantily clad barmaid at another establishment, Melvin delivers divorce papers that grant him sole custody of Darcy. The couple fights, and Lynda quits.
